channel.title: MCP :: Gonemaster
channel.description: gonemaster exposes its testing and analysis tools to AI agents over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). A connected agent can run a test, read and search stored runs, diff two runs, and roll up a batch: the grade distribution, the tags driving failures, the values an argument takes across a cohort, and a classified comparison of two cohort snapshots. The tools call the admin API of gonemaster-server; they run no engine of their own.
